event_id.description: Unique identifier for the security event

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred

source.description: Log source or sensor (e.g. auth.log, edr, firewall)

event_type.description: Type of event (e.g. authentication_failure, process_creation, outbound_connection)

host.description: Hostname or IP of affected system

raw_data.description: Raw unparsed or semi-structured event payload
